pages.text: Prepare 14 tempered steel and 13 Gun Screws. Make one tempered spring, then the hammer, pan and trigger. Join these into one complete lock.
Finish one short barrel. Carve one hardwood blank and bind it into the pistol stock. Prepare one brass band and one ramrod.

Bring the assemblies to the final pistol pattern. Reserve its extra screw, steel and leather.$(br2)Three precision mechanisms are consumed across the barrel, trigger and lock. The finished FK15P is unloaded.
